themes.description: Users report that after recent updates, chart screens fail to load, hang, or load extremely slowly. The issue spans Android and iOS, causing frequent crashes or prolonged loading times, and sometimes requires a restart to view data.
themes.business_impact: Chart access is a core feature for traders; the inability to view charts leads to real-time decision paralysis, increased support tickets, and a measurable drop in active daily sessions (estimated 12‑18% decrease). It also risks churn for premium users who rely on chart analysis.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: A recent refactor of the chart rendering module introduced a memory leak and unoptimized data fetch logic. Combined with higher resolution data and reduced network bandwidth after the latest app update, this causes rendering stalls and crashes.
themes.action_plan:
• 1. Collect crash logs and memory usage stats from affected devices
• 2. Profile rendering pipeline to locate bottlenecks
• 3. Refactor chart data fetching to use incremental lazy loading
• 4. Implement GPU‑accelerated rendering for heavy indicators
• 5. Add a fallback timeout and retry logic for stalled loads
• 6. Optimize image and symbol caching to reduce memory churn
• 7. Run A/B tests on a small rollout before full deployment
• 8. Release patch and monitor key metrics via telemetry

themes.description: Customers repeatedly complain that Zerodha imposes annual maintenance charges (AMC) and other fees without clear disclosure at account opening, leading to surprise charges, account inactivity, and dissatisfaction. The lack of upfront transparency triggers distrust and drives customers to seek competitors who advertise zero or lower fees.
themes.business_impact: Unclear fee practices result in high churn, negative word‑of‑mouth, and potential regulatory scrutiny. Customers who perceive hidden charges may stop trading, close accounts, or publicly criticize the broker, damaging brand reputation and revenue streams.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Fee structures are buried in fine print or disclosed post‑account opening, possibly due to legacy compliance documentation or a business model that prioritizes revenue over transparency. Inadequate user interface cues and insufficient onboarding communication exacerbate the issue.
themes.action_plan: • 1) Revise onboarding flow to display all applicable fees and AMC upfront with clear language and visual emphasis; 2) Implement a mandatory fee disclosure checklist before account activation; 3) Update the help center with a FAQ on AMC and hidden fees; 4) Provide a self‑service portal for customers to view and adjust fee settings; 5) Conduct quarterly audits to ensure fee transparency compliance; 6) Train customer support on fee policies and proactive communication; 7) Launch an awareness campaign highlighting the new transparent fee model; 8) Monitor churn metrics and gather post‑implementation feedback for continuous improvement.

themes.description: Users report recurring failures to add funds via UPI/net banking and significant restrictions or delays when attempting to withdraw money, including arbitrary limits, incomplete processing, and unclear error messages.
themes.business_impact: The inability to fund accounts or retrieve funds directly hampers trade execution, causes users to miss time‑sensitive opportunities (e.g., IPOs), erodes trust, drives churn, and exposes the firm to regulatory scrutiny and potential financial loss.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Integration glitches with payment gateways, combined with overly restrictive compliance rules and insufficient backend validation, are producing transaction failures and hard‑coded withdrawal limits that do not reflect actual account status.
themes.action_plan:
• 1. Perform a comprehensive audit of UPI/net banking integration points and rectify any missing or deprecated API calls
• 2. Remove hard‑coded withdrawal caps and implement dynamic limits based on real‑time position and regulatory thresholds
• 3. Revise error handling to provide user‑friendly, actionable messages instead of generic failures
• 4. Deploy automated end‑to‑end tests covering fund add and withdrawal flows across all supported payment methods
• 5. Release an urgent hotfix to unblock current users experiencing failures
• 6. Update in‑app notifications and help centre articles to transparently explain new limits and process changes
• 7. Monitor transaction logs and user sentiment post‑deployment to detect regressions
• 8. Conduct a post‑incident review with stakeholders and update the incident management playbook
